findings.observation: The primary was positive in 3/6 independent quarters; the worst was fold-06-2024q4 at net -135.62779180197950912042340.
findings.interpretation_limit: Independent fold resets use fold-local rebalance anchors, so quarter results diagnose instability but do not sum to continuous replay P/L.

findings.observation: Positive folds increased from 2 at the fast horizon to 4 at the slow horizon; slow base net was 707.06610242304561816341280.
findings.interpretation_limit: The slow variant was a non-selectable falsification check. This ordering may motivate research but cannot promote or replace the primary.

findings.observation: Primary net changed from 330.22820580728073020521080 at base cost to 273.65069521560358276600080 at double cost with turnover 34.0645897673706959909892.
findings.interpretation_limit: Cost robustness does not establish temporal robustness or future exchange execution quality.

findings.observation: Primary full-window rebalances averaged 17.925 positive markets; 2 rebalances held cash for insufficient breadth.
findings.interpretation_limit: Breadth was observed after outcomes and cannot be thresholded into a new entry filter without a separately registered study.
Drawdown timing is descriptive and cannot justify a post-hoc regime switch or exposure filter.

findings.observation: Trades in the three losing independent quarters summed to net -217.88664348369658698021225 across all frozen exit reasons.
findings.interpretation_limit: Exit-reason attribution is not causal; changing stops or rebalance exits after observing these outcomes would be rescue tuning.
BTC, ETH, and SOL are diagnostic-only and cannot enter rankings, gates, or a new regime rule from this analysis.

findings.observation: Leave-one-market-out positivity was 1; both frozen concentration gates passed.
findings.interpretation_limit: Broad symbol robustness supports continued mechanism research but does not cure the failed quarterly gate.
